NGA.note: 120,040,000 enrolled is stated with no population or share.
No operation or maintenance of the system stated.
NIN is said to be required for banking, telecoms and loans, but no public register keyed on it is named.

facts.fact: NIMC's Director-General said on 14 May 2025 that 120,040,000 Nigerians were enrolled in the National Identity Database, whose capacity was raised from 100 million to 250 million.

NGA.note: No biometric duplicate check or audit stated.
State and local offices equipped for NIN registration is equipment, with no connection stated.
